question: What is the name of the first made-in-India 32-bit processor chip presented at Semicon India 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VIKRAM3201**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The first made-in-India 32-bit processor chip, Vikram-32, was presented at Semicon India 2025 by Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw to Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Vikram-32 is the first fully indigenous 32-bit microprocessor designed by ISRO's Semiconductor Laboratory (SCL) for space missions.**
 
• It is a successor to VIKRAM1601, the 16-bit processor that powered ISRO's launch vehicles since 2009.
 
• The Vikram-32 is built on a 32-bit architecture, capable of handling complex aerospace and satellite computations, supporting floating-point operations and the Ada programming language.
 
• The development of the Vikram-32 is a significant milestone in India's self-reliance efforts under the India Semiconductor Mission and Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vikram-32 Chip__

 __
 
• The Vikram-32 is a 32-bit processor specifically designed to withstand extreme conditions of rocket launches and space environments.
 
• It is the first microprocessor of its kind, qualified for use in space missions by ISRO.
 
 
 
• India Semiconductor Mission__
 __
 
• The India Semiconductor Mission, launched in 2021, aims to reduce India's dependence on imported chips and promote self-reliance in semiconductor technology.
 
 
 
• Semicon India 2025__
 
 
• Semicon India 2025 is a three-day conference aimed at strengthening India’s semiconductor ecosystem, with discussions on chip fabrication, AI, and investment opportunities in the sector.
